title: Rabbi Abba bar Elisha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 80:7 and Midrash Tehillim 22:22, adding to Resh Lakish’s words. Buber holds that he is the figure mentioned in Yuchasin as Rabbi Abba bar Elishiv, in the time of Rabbi Mani son of Rabbi Yonah. Hyman finds no other mention of him. In Taanit 22b, only Rabbi Yitzchak bar Elishiv is found, with whom Rabbi Mani was often present. Vayikra Rabbah 35:6 mentions Rabbi Acha bar Elishiv.

notes.text: Buber’s supplied initials הר״ש do not justify the earlier draft’s invented “Shneur” expansion. The quoted Abba/Yitzchak/Acha bar Elishiv forms are retained separately from the entry’s Abba bar Elisha heading.
